## IdeaViewTxt v0.1.4

The popup's text could jump or rewrap while you were reading: the page-turn hotkeys were swallowed by the caret model, the rendered layout was rebuilt in a race with its own animation, and the caret was parked at the end of the page. All three are fixed. The popup's placement and the triple-tap trigger were also reworked: the popup now sits right under the caret, and the three trigger characters are typed normally instead of being swallowed.

## Fixes

### Page navigation keys reach the popup

The hotkeys for next / previous page were installed as ordinary key listeners while the panel kept focus inside a Swing text component — the caret model processed `UP` / `DOWN` / `LEFT` / `RIGHT` first, so page turns were swallowed by ordinary caret movement. Key handling now sits on the popup's `InputMap` / `ActionMap` and consumes the events before the text component sees them, so every turn lands on the next (or previous) page instead of moving a caret you cannot see.

### One layout per page

Page size and rendering were computed in two passes, and the rendering pass re-derived the line layout from the live font metrics. Between the two passes the popup's fade-in animation could change the effective font size, so the page you were reading re-wrapped under you — or, worse, the cursor advanced by a size that never matched the text on screen. The layout is now computed once per page and reused for both rendering and the cursor advance, so what you read is exactly what was counted.

### The caret stays out of the way

The popup left the caret at the end of the rendered page, which made the component scroll itself back to the bottom right after you had scrolled up to read. The caret is now positioned at the start of the page and its updates are suppressed while the popup is showing, so the view stays where you put it.

### The popup anchors to the caret

The popup used to open to the lower-right of the caret with a hard-coded 70 px horizontal offset, positioned once from a screen point captured at trigger time. It now opens directly below the caret with its left edge aligned to it, flipping to the other side near screen edges. It tracks caret movement and editor scrolling while open, and closes itself when its anchor scrolls out of the editor viewport — no more orphaned popups floating over the wrong place.

### The trigger characters type normally

The third keystroke of the triple tap used to be consumed, so the character it produced never reached the document. Now all three characters are typed as usual; the trigger offset is recorded after the editor has processed the third character, and the popup opens there. Key handling is installed per editor through the `editorFactoryListener` extension point instead of a shared counter map, auto-repeat (holding the key down) no longer counts as a triple tap, and each editor's listeners are removed when it is released.

| `IdeaViewTxt-0.1.4.zip` | Plugin distribution — *Settings → Plugins → ⚙ → Install Plugin from Disk…* |

## Notes

- Built against IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1.7, `sinceBuild = 241`, so it loads in 2024.1 and later (any edition that ships the platform modules it depends on — `com.intellij.modules.platform` only).
- Settings are per project, in `.idea/viewTxt.xml`: file path, trigger key, starting index, popup width and height. Deleting that file resets the panel.
- The triple tap is a plain-key sequence on purpose: a single keystroke cannot be bound without stealing it from typing, and a modifier combination would have to fight the IDE's own keymap. The counter resets after two seconds of inactivity or when focus leaves the editor.
- Stack: Kotlin 2.1 · IntelliJ Platform Gradle Plugin 2.10 · Gradle 9 · Java 17 bytecode.
